title: TC-SAW (Temperature Compensated SAW) - Band 38 (2600 MHz TDD) for 5G NR Sub-6 GHz Front-End Module
subtitle: Design Validation and Performance Characterization
author: Dr. Raj Patel

sections.1_OBJECTIVE: This document describes the design, simulation, and characterization of a TC-SAW (Temperature Compensated SAW) filter targeting Band 38 (2600 MHz TDD) for 5G NR Sub-6 GHz Front-End Module. The filter is designed on 128° YX LiNbO3 substrate with a target center frequency of 5683.7 MHz and bandwidth of 68.3 MHz. The objective is to validate that the filter meets the required insertion loss, rejection, and linearity specifications for integration into the 5G NR Sub-6 GHz Front-End Module module. This design iteration addresses feedback from the previous revision regarding out-of-band rejection improvements and temperature stability.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Filter Type: TC-SAW (Temperature Compensated SAW)
- Frequency Band: Band 38 (2600 MHz TDD)
- Application: 5G NR Sub-6 GHz Front-End Module
- Substrate: 128° YX LiNbO3
- Package: Fan-Out WLP
- Design Tool: Matlab RF Toolbox R2024b
- Design Center: Irvine Design Center

This specification applies to all variants of the TC-SAW (Temperature Compensated SAW) design targeting Band 38 (2600 MHz TDD). Results are used to qualify the design for mass production release.
sections.3_DESIGN_PARAMETERS:
Center Frequency:       5683.7 MHz
Bandwidth (3 dB):       68.3 MHz
Insertion Loss Target:  <= 1.7 dB
Return Loss Target:     >= 22.0 dB
Out-of-Band Rejection:  >= 47.0 dB
Isolation (Duplexer):   >= 32.0 dB
Q Factor:               5215
Temperature Coefficient:-23.3 ppm/°C
Die Size:               1.0 x 1.9 mm
Wafer Size:             6-inch
Number of Resonators:   11
Electrode Material:     Al
Passivation:            SiO2
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Open Matlab RF Toolbox R2024b and load the TC-SAW (Temperature Compensated SAW) template project.
2. Define the substrate stack: 128° YX LiNbO3 with specified layer thicknesses.
3. Set design targets: center freq 5683.7 MHz, BW 68.3 MHz.
4. Run initial EM simulation with 2D mesh density of 20 cells/wavelength.
5. Optimize resonator geometry using gradient descent (target IL < 1.7 dB).
6. Verify coupling coefficients between resonator stages.
7. Run 3D FEM simulation to account for package parasitics (Fan-Out WLP).
8. Export GDS-II layout for mask fabrication.
9. Fabricate prototype wafers (6-inch, 128° YX LiNbO3).
10. Perform on-wafer probing using Rohde & Schwarz ZNA67.
11. Measure S-parameters (S11, S21, S12, S22) from 100 MHz to 17051 MHz.
12. Compare measured results against simulation and specification limits.
13. Perform temperature cycling (-40°C to +85°C) and re-measure.
14. Document results and generate summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Insertion loss at center frequency shall be <= 1.7 dB
- Return loss in passband shall be >= 22.0 dB
- Out-of-band rejection at +/- 102 MHz offset >= 47.0 dB
- Group delay variation across passband shall be <= 3 ns
- Temperature drift over -40°C to +85°C shall be <= 16.6 MHz
- Power handling shall be >= +30 dBm at 1 dB compression
- ESD tolerance >= 2000 V (HBM)
- Die yield on qualification lot >= 87%
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Measurement Date:       2025-04-02
Devices Tested:         10
Insertion Loss (meas):  1.36 dB
Return Loss (meas):     24.3 dB
Rejection (meas):       49.9 dB
Isolation (meas):       37.3 dB
Q Factor (meas):        5215
Group Delay Variation:  5.5 ns
Power Handling:         +28 dBm
Die Yield:              94.7%

Result Classification:  CONDITIONAL PASS
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The TC-SAW (Temperature Compensated SAW) design demonstrated acceptable performance for Band 38 (2600 MHz TDD).
b) Insertion loss met target specification.
c) Out-of-band rejection exceeded the minimum requirement.
d) Group delay flatness improved compared to previous revision.
e) Wafer-level uniformity was excellent (sigma < 1.5%).
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
1. Review near-band rejection margin for worst-case temperature.
2. Re-run EM simulation with refined mesh for better accuracy.
3. Schedule follow-up measurement after design tweak.
